summary: The implementation preserves unusual morphology and defines apparent central-body width with explicit missingness, while retained tests support rotation stability, endpoint trimming, representative-plane selection, and legacy-field separation. Conditional acceptance is appropriate because the evidence remains segmentation-mask and synthetic-test based, with limited independent biological adjudication and substantial width missingness in retained artifacts.

evidence: sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:3387-3457 defines perpendicular contour chords through the central body, trims endpoints, and returns unavailable values when insufficient chords exist.
tests/test_saturn_v571_body_width.py:test_subpixel_body_width_is_rotation_stable covers five rotations and known-width synthetic rectangles.
tests/test_saturn_v571_body_width.py:test_representative_track_width_uses_largest_area_not_widest_plane verifies that the largest filled-mask area, rather than the widest plane, supplies track width.

tests/test_saturn_v571_body_width.py:test_measurement_exports_legacy_and_new_width_fields and test_analysis_summary_uses_body_width_as_primary_and_labels_legacy verify primary versus explicitly labelled legacy fields.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:7333-7340 selects apparent body width for primary summaries and retains EDT-derived fields as legacy.

audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/report/02_quality_control/data/specimen_sensitivity_artifact.json:20-21 reports width missingness separately and distinguishes sampled ROI volume from anatomical organ volume.
audits/claims_registry.json:78-97 lists the apparent-mask and PSF-related limitations, but no independent biological manual-width adjudication artifact was found.
audits/validation/v571_6f9e73b_validation.md:74-75 states that the retained representative specimens validate execution and provenance only and do not establish a biological group effect.

findings.title: Biological width validity remains bounded by segmentation appearance
findings.impact: The field supports comparative apparent mask morphology but cannot establish true nucleus diameter, particularly for unusual mutant shapes, focus variation, annotation thickness, or lateral PSF effects.
evidence: audits/claims_registry.json:91-95 defines boundary, focus, annotation-thickness, and lateral-PSF limitations and explicitly disclaims molecular-scale width.
audits/V5_7_1_DESIGN_DECISIONS.md:55-58 labels width as apparent mask width rather than deconvolved molecular diameter.
findings.recommendation: Retain the apparent-width nomenclature and add independently adjudicated biological examples spanning unusual mutant width and taper phenotypes before interpreting group-level width effects.

findings.title: Width availability is incomplete in retained production evidence
findings.impact: A substantial subset of technically valid tracks lacks the new width measurement, so width-based summaries may represent a selected measurable subset unless missingness is explicitly reported and assessed.
evidence: audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/report/02_quality_control/data/specimen_sensitivity_artifact.json:29-37 reports KJ-01 width availability of 0.7806779047 and 1,210 estimated missing widths.
audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/report/02_quality_control/data/specimen_sensitivity_artifact.json:20-21 specifies that width missingness is reported separately.
findings.recommendation: Carry width availability and missingness into every biological width comparison and verify that missingness is not associated with specimen, genotype, slice position, or morphology warning.

limitations: No full stack was run, per instruction.
Independent biological manual-width labels were not available for this read-only review.
Retained production evidence contains only two complete representative specimens and does not establish a biological group effect.
The measurement is apparent segmented-mask width and remains sensitive to optical and segmentation factors.
recommended_follow_up: Obtain blinded biological adjudication of width overlays for typical, tapered, curved, short, and unusual mutant morphology.
Report width missingness by specimen and morphology category alongside primary width summaries.
